source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Separator rails have little or none of the repeated background color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == background for v in grid[r]) < w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) < h / 2]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            color = grid[r0][c0]
            if (color != background and color != 0 and
                grid[r0][c1] == color and grid[r1][c0] == color and grid[r1][c1] == color):
                line.append(color)
            else:
                line.append(background)
        out.append(line)
    while out and all(v == background for v in out[0]):
        out.pop(0)
    while out and all(v == background for v in out[-1]):
        out.pop()
    while out and all(line[0] == background for line in out):
        for line in out:
            line.pop(0)
    while out and all(line[-1] == background for line in out):
        for line in out:
            line.pop()
    return out
'''
